title: Eye of the Pyramid
description: A surreal scene inside a vast hall where a large crowd in robes gathers on a checkered floor. A grand spiral staircase ascends toward a massive glowing all-seeing eye set within a cracked hexagonal frame and lotus petals, all enclosed in a giant green pyramid. Film reels and film strips float in the dark sky above while two silhouetted figures stand on the stairs.
prompt: Surreal symbolic artwork of a vast tiled hall filled with a crowd of robed figures. A dramatic red spiral staircase rises toward a giant glowing all-seeing eye inside a cracked hexagonal emblem surrounded by lotus petals. The eye is framed within a massive green pyramid against a dark stormy sky. Film reels and strips float in the air. Two silhouetted figures stand on the stairs, one holding a film reel. Red floral patterns adorn the walls with a faint world map visible. Dark, mystical and ominous atmosphere.
